title.en: Restructuring the Technology Resource Center By Increasing Its Capitalization
title.orig: Restructuring the Technology Resource Center By Increasing Its Capitalization

text.en:
The capitalization of TRC is hereby increased to TWO HUNDRED THIRTY FIVE MILLION PESOS
(P235,000,000.00) whereby the additional amount of ONE HUNDRED FIFTY MILLION PESOS
(P150,000,000.00) is hereby appropriated out of any funds of the Government not otherwise appropriated
which amount shall be programmed and released to TRC by the Ministry of the Budget.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 12th day of February, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
